exposure: first-trimester cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fetal fraction (<5%, normal, >95%)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1,041 twin pregnancies screened for aneuploidy using cfDNA in the first trimester between December 2011 and February 2022, excluding those with positive screen results for chromosomal aneuploidy.
finding: There was no association between the extremes of cfDNA fetal fraction (low or high) and birth weight <10th percentile or <5th percentile in twin gestations.
birth_weight: Babies with birth weight <10th percentile and <5th percentile were analyzed.
